loop.purpose: Suggest relevance and evidence passages from actual retrieved papers for full biologist checking
loop.input: Actual original papers, explicit review criteria and extraction questions

tasks.design: Use native search/deduplication first in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the research reference system, adding a bounded loop for candidate relevance/evidence passages from actual retrieved originals.
